The hull is built from large segmented plates in weathered white and cool gray, with thin faded orange stripes, rows of small amber window lights along the flank, a few hangar doors on the belly, and clustered engine bells at the blunt stern. Clean silhouette, limited palette, crisp pixel edges, no background scenery.
